title: Describing a mood presentation: what changed, for how long, and who says so

objectives.statement: Write each element of a person's mood presentation so that it states what changed, over what period, and whether the person reported it, someone else reported it, or it was observed in the conversation.

Decide, for the depressive, elevated, irritable, mixed, psychotic, cognitive, sleep, energy, and functional elements, which are present, which are absent, and which were never established, and record the second and third of those as findings.
Describe a past episode reported from memory at the strength its source supports, giving its dates, its content, and its provenance, without converting it into a classification.

scenes.title: A line that nobody can check
Three things every element has to carry
Nine kinds of change, one person
Assembling R.'s description from the raw material
Tag it, finish it, write it
Reading a description you did not write
Clinical wrap-up: eleven weeks later, has anything changed?
